value.title: Method handling on static paths: 405 Allow GET, HEAD, fall-through after a route's method mismatch, OPTIONS and 501 order

acceptanceCriteria.text: Under `app.staticFiles("/", root)` with no route for the path, `POST /assets/app.js`, `PUT /assets/app.js` and `DELETE /docs/` (a directory with an index file) are answered `405` with `Allow: GET, HEAD`, and the file is not sent. [D-260] Decision: a method other than `GET` or `HEAD` gets the static `405` only when a `GET` would be served; otherwise the router's answer (`404` or the route's `405`) stands. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-6-6 SDS-AC-8]

`OPTIONS /assets/app.js` on a static-only path is answered `405` with `Allow: GET, HEAD`, the automatic `204` of D-395 applies to explicit routes only, and an unknown method token or a disabled `TRACE`/`CONNECT` on that path is answered with the router's `501` before any static mount lookup. Decision: the order is the FR-HTTP-021 AC-2 pre-check order (`OPTIONS *` `204`, raw path not starting with `/` `400`, `PathValidator` `400`, unknown-token `501`), then the router lookup with the disabled `TRACE`/`CONNECT` `501` of FR-HTTP-022 AC-4, then the static mounts, so a `PathValidator` `400` still comes before either `501`. [wave decision: OPTIONS on a static-only path; D-260; D-395]

With only `POST /login` registered and `root/login` a file, `GET /login` and `HEAD /login` are served from the mount; with `spaFallback(true)` and no file `GET /login` (with `Accept: text/html`) receives the SPA index; with no mount serving it `GET /login` receives the route's `405` with the route's own `Allow`; and `PUT /login` receives the route's `405` with the route's own `Allow`, with no `Allow` values merged. [wave decision: Static files after a route's method mismatch; D-259; D-260]

A path that a WebSocket route of the router owns is never served from a static mount or by SPA fallback, even when a file of that name exists. Decision: in wave 6, where `app.ws` does not exist yet, the test registers the WebSocket route through the internal router. [wave decision: Static files after a route's method mismatch; D-265]

The `405` with `Allow: GET, HEAD` applies only when a `GET` for the same path would be answered from the file system (a file, a directory index, a directory listing or the trailing-slash `301`); SPA fallback content does not count, so under a `/` mount with `spaFallback(true)` `POST /missing`, `POST /api/typo` and `POST /.env` receive `404` (a T27 case). A path that D-052 or D-268 rejects receives `400` for every recognised, enabled method because path validation runs before method handling: `POST /a/..%2Fb` and paths with an encoded `/` or `NUL` get the `PathValidator` `400` of FR-HTTP-021; for a path that no explicit route matches and that lies under a static mount prefix, the static D-268 check runs before the static `405`/`404` method decision, so `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE` and `OPTIONS` of `/%252e%252e/secret.txt` and `/a%252Fb` under a `/` mount all receive `400` (test cases). Explicit routes still take precedence: with `app.post("/:x", h)` registered, `POST /a%252Fb` reaches `h`. [residual: served only by a static mount; D-260; D-262; D-265; D-268; D-271; T27]

value.requirement: The system shall answer a non-`GET`/`HEAD` request with `405` and `Allow: GET, HEAD` only when a `GET` for the same path would be answered from the file system by a static mount, let `GET` and `HEAD` fall through to the static mounts when a route matches the path but not the method, keep the route's own `405` and `Allow` otherwise, answer unknown or disabled methods with the router's `501` before any static mount lookup, run the static path checks before the static method decision, and never serve a path owned by a WebSocket route from a static mount.
value.rationale: Covers D-260, the wave decisions "Static files after a route's method mismatch" (W2-005, r2 W2-004, r3 W2-003; D-259, D-260, D-395, D-265) and "OPTIONS on a static-only path" (W2-006; D-260, D-395; r3 W2-002), and the residual "What served only by a static mount means" (r5 W2-001; D-260, D-262, D-265, D-271, D-395). Builds on FR-HTTP-022 (fallback point, OPTIONS 204 for routes only), FR-ROUTE-010 (the route's own Allow set, no merge), FR-HTTP-021 and FR-ROUTE-004 (path validation `400` before method handling). FR-HTTP-022 scenarios register routes only and stay true. Rejected alternative: merging the route's `Allow` with `GET, HEAD`; the wave decision rejects merged `Allow` values.
